Research position overview

The Cancer Research UK Manchester Institute recruits researchers for a four-year PhD programme. Applicants select research interests within the Institute's cancer science groups and compete for studentships that support tuition, living costs and the costs of the research project.

Research Areas

  • Cancer biology
  • Biomedical science
  • Cancer research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryGBP 21,113 year 1; 22,500 year 2; 22,894 year 3; 23,294 year 4
DurationFour years

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsUK, EU and international applicants; tuition and bench costs supported.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round6 November 2026, 17:00 GMT
LocationUnited Kingdom
Details checked9 October 2026

About University of Manchester

Manchester hosts doctoral programmes in medicine, bioscience and other research fields. Its Faculty of Biology, Medicine and Health coordinates funded training routes, including MRC programmes and cancer research studentships.
